steps.en: Review the checkout and start the core stack
steps.zh: 审阅源码并启动核心服务

steps.en: Generate deployment secrets and prepare the local model
steps.zh: 生成部署密钥并准备本地模型

steps.en: Connect a vendor or send authenticated security events
steps.zh: 接入厂商或推送已认证的安全事件

steps.en: Normalize events, detect matches and group alerts
steps.zh: 归一化事件，检测命中并归组告警

steps.en: Triage the alert and record its verdict and investigation steps
steps.zh: 初筛告警并保存结论与调查步骤

value.en: Review an alert with its recorded decision path instead of reconstructing a model verdict by hand
value.zh: 连同已记录的决策路径复核告警，不再手工还原模型结论
